correctness.rationale: For the explicit 12-vertex Chvátal graph (24 edges, degree4 with a four-cycle) and source loopless C5, independently enumerating every valid ordered five-tuple of nonempty target color subsets under complete adjacency gave f=(440,760,280,20), exactly 1500 regular CW cells with no higher cells. The graph-Hom construction is exhaustive because each cell contains a singleton homomorphism and is reached by adding allowed colors. An independent greedy free-face elementary-collapse algorithm (not merely replaying the package certificate) removes exactly 20 (2,3)-cell pairs and 260 (1,2)-cell pairs, ending with connected graph of 440 vertices and 500 edges, cyclomatic rank 61. Thus integral homotopy wedge of 61 circles. Independent signed fixed-cell Lefschetz enumeration of all eight target automorphisms recovers H1 traces 61,1,1,-9,1 by dihedral classes and character decomposition multiplicities (6,10,5,10,15). Collapse not claimed equivariant; homology character derived before collapse.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS. Both inspected square-free codomain classification theorems explicitly require no 4-cycles; the Chvátal graph has a 4-cycle, so they cannot imply its Hom(C5,H) rank or representation. The fully read published Groetzsch target calculation has 11 vertices and 41 rather than 61 circles and no Chvátal dihedral character. Petersen and complete-target Hom theorems concern inequivalent target graphs. The exact full target automorphism H1 character is an additional genuine invariant.
